name: ai-proposal-writer-anna
tagline: AI Proposal Creation & Management Workspace for Agencies, Consultancies & Freelancers.
description:
AI Proposal Writer is a complete AI proposal creation, quality assurance, and deal management workspace purpose-built for digital agencies, consultancies, freelance developers, and creative studios.

Transform unstructured project briefs into comprehensive, professionally formatted client proposals in minutes using Anna's native AI sampling, deterministic pricing math, automated quality audits, and interactive client presentation.

### Key Capabilities & Workflow

1. Brief-to-Proposal Intelligence & Scoping Wizard:
- Instant RFP & Brief Ingestion: Paste raw client emails or project briefs to auto-populate scope, client facts, and budget parameters.
- Battle-tested Industry Templates: Software & App Development, Enterprise AI/ML, Cloud & IT Consulting, Digital Marketing Retainer, UI/UX Design, and Custom Engineering.
- Granular 4-Step Scoping: Client context, objectives, deliverables, architecture, milestones, and commercial terms.

2. AI Proposal Quality Assurance (QA Auditor):
- Real-time 0-100 Quality Score evaluating Completeness, Clarity, Scope Specificity, Pricing Math, and Risk Coverage.
- Transparent criteria with actionable improvement suggestions and missing-section alerts before client delivery.

3. Deterministic Pricing & Milestone Builder:
- Interactive itemized quotation engine with quantities, rates, discounts, tax calculations, and currency selection (USD, EUR, GBP, INR, CAD, AUD).
- Milestone payment schedules with deposit protection and deterministic mathematical integrity.

4. Advanced Proposal Workbench & AI Writing Assistant:
- Drag-and-drop section reordering, section creation, deletion, and inline Markdown editing.
- Inline AI operations: Polish in Executive Tone, Make Concise, Expand Technical Details, Simplify Language, and Add Risk Matrices.
- Revision snapshot history: save named versions and restore previous drafts safely.

5. Client Review Experience & PDF Generation:
- Distraction-free interactive client presentation mode with dynamic optional add-on recalculations and formal sign-off acceptance.
- One-click branded PDF export with custom company theme colors, table of contents, itemized tables, delivery roadmaps, and signature blocks.

6. Lifecycle Workspace Management:
- Track proposals through Draft, Internal Review, Sent, Accepted, Rejected, and Archived.
- Full search, filtering, and proposal duplication workflows backed by Anna Host Storage.
